text:
Keisha: quick check  thinking about renaming the inline CTA to 'Preview history' instead of 'Preview recent alerts' and changing behavior: for single-channel rules open small flyout; for multi-channel rules open a panel that shows per-channel timelines. keeps parity with how users think of 'history' vs 'preview'. thoughts? :thought_balloon:
Oliver: i like the explicitness. main concern: users who expect to see 'recent sends' might not find 'history'. maybe keep 'Preview history' and have tooltip 'Show recent sends by channel'.
Ben: design/space note: compact rows should use a glyph + 'Preview' micro-link; full text 'Preview history' only in expanded rule view. avoid increasing row height.
Sophie: keyboard flow: channels -> suppression -> preview. if preview is per-channel timeline, allow arrow keys inside the panel to switch channels so keyboard users don't have to tab many times.
A11y Bot: a11y rec: trigger needs aria-haspopup and an accessible name like "Preview history for selected channels". if panel shows per-channel panes use role="tablist" + role="tab" for keyboard switching. update aria-live region whenever timeline loads with "History loaded: X events for Y channels".
Keisha: good. copy notes: tooltip variants: short = "Show recent sends"; full = "Preview history: up to 50 sends per channel". For suppressed channels tooltip should append "(includes suppressed sends)".
Oliver: behavior edge: when suppression is set at the rule-level vs channel-level we need to be explicit. suggest the panel show a tiny badge per channel: "suppressed" or "active" and a help link: "why suppressed?" that opens docs.
Ben: perf: lazy-fetch timeline only when user expands. cache per-rule preview for 20s. indicate cached state with a subtle clock icon + tooltip "Showing cached history".
Sophie: focus management: popover variant should move focus into the panel but not trap it; modal variant must trap. closing should return focus to the trigger and announce "Preview closed" to SR users.
A11y Bot: color/contrast: micro-link must be >=4.5:1 at small text. focus outline must be visible (min 2px) and have 3:1 contrast with background. keyboard shortcut hint: offer 'H' to open history only after first use; present hint as "Press H to open history" in a non-modal toast. ensure it can be disabled in keyboard prefs.
Keisha: telemetry: event name `preview_history.open` with properties: rule_id, variant:compact|panel, channels:[...], suppressed:bool, cached:bool, result_count:int. also fire `preview_history.refresh` on manual refresh. Oliver can you add this to analytics doc?
Oliver: will add. also recommend a small success metric: percent of previews that return >0 results to detect regressions.
Ben: I'll mock compact micro-link + clock cached state in storybook and keep code snippet minimal: `<button aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="Preview history for selected channels">Preview</button>` and fire telemetry on click.
Sophie: i'll draft keyboard interactions (arrow key switches, esc to close, restore focus) and add to the PR checklist along with color checks and SR announcements.
Keisha: perfect. i'll update Figma with two variants and push a short doc about naming rationale. tagging for UX review and keyboard QA. :white_check_mark:
